Hi Alex —

Thanks for the recap, and apologies for the slow reply — pulled the numbers from our platform: 

- Expected monthly token volume: 120M–180M tokens (steady-state target: ~150M tokens/month).
- Peak TPS: steady-state ~3–5 TPS; short bursts up to ~18 TPS (we have a few end-of-day batch jobs and marketing spikes).
- Avg tokens per request: ~200 tokens (120 token prompt, 80 token response on average).
- Target budget: looking at ~$3k–$6k/mo depending on SLA and committed discounts.
- Target unit economics: ideally around $20 per 1M tokens (that aligns with our budget target at ~150M tokens -> ~$3k/mo).
- Latency: 99th percentile ideally < 500ms for user-facing calls; batch jobs can tolerate higher latency.

I attached a short token profile export (FinPay_token_profile.xlsx) with hourly breakdown for the last 30 days. Happy to jump back on a quick call to clarify.
